usage: Use Drawer to help users navigate through your application or content hierarchy. This component provides clear wayfinding and helps users understand their current location within the interface.

Drawer is ideal for multi-page applications, content-heavy interfaces, or any situation where users need to move between different sections. Keep navigation patterns consistent across your application for better user experience.
